OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:

          description: The validation message.
          type: string

      required:

          maxLength: 255

## What I implemented

When an owner is created without a `registrationDate`, it now defaults to the server's current date; a supplied date is preserved. The value is stored and returned as an ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` string.

## Changes (kept as small, low-coupling units)

1. **`OwnerRegistrationDateAdvice`** (new) — a tiny `RequestBodyAdviceAdapter` that sets `registrationDate = LocalDate.now()` on the incoming `OwnerFieldsDto` only when it's null. This mirrors the existing `OwnerEmailNormalizationAdvice` pattern, so the default-date rule lives in its own cohesive class instead of growing the controller (which has high surrounding complexity).

2. **`Owner` entity** — added a persisted `registrationDate` field (`@Column(name = "registration_date")`) plus its getter/setter and the `LocalDate` import. This is the only edit to an existing class, and just adds simple accessors.

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added `registrationDate` (`type: string, format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` schema, so the generated DTO both accepts it on `POST` and echoes it on `GET`. MapStruct maps it by name automatically, so the mapper needed no changes.

4. **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql` / `data.sql`** — added the `registration_date DATE` column and extended the positional seed inserts to match. hsqldb is the test database (`ddl-auto=none`); the main-app h2 profile uses `ddl-auto=update`, which adds the column automatically after script init, so those files didn't need touching.

The default logic and the mapping flow through fresh/low-complexity units, and no existing method's body was grown — only accessors were added.

**Tests:** `AcceptanceTest` (both `coreDefaultsToToday` and `functionalityKeepsSuppliedDate`) and the full `mvn test` suite pass — `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`, `BUILD SUCCESS`.
